description:
Cha Yul is the youngest son of a wealthy noble family with a long lineage. Curious about everything in the world, Yul carries a secret he cannot let anyone know. He is in a romantic relationship with a slave named Myeonghu.

Myeonghu, a mixed blood descendant of a Saekmok lineage, already stands out for his striking looks. On top of that, he constantly teases Yul without caring who is around, leaving him flustered and embarrassed.

Then Yul is put in charge of the village’s biggest festival, the Lantern Festival. This year’s festival has to be a success, no matter what.

*“So, Myeonghu… how about we cut down on how often we fool around?”*
